summary_md: **Alan ([@localllmrig](https://x.com/localllmrig/status/2115383593879077001))** describes n8n's no-cloud-API agent stack running a 35B MoE (vLLM NVFP4) on a 128 GB DGX Spark, and lists what fits on a 24 GB GPU at Q4 (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 23.1 GB, Qwen3 Coder 30B A3B 20.2 GB, Gemma 4 26B A4B 18.1 GB), linking his can-I-run page; a follow-up corrects the count to 25 of 42 models fitting 24 GB at standard Q4 (not 26, which had included 1–3-bit quants), noting all three listed models still fit.

referenced_urls.title: Which GPUs and Macs run Qwen3.6-35B-A3B? RTX 3090/4090/5090

relevance: Memory-fit numbers for agent-friendly ~30B MoE models on Spark versus a 24 GB card.
